title: Why Crossplay 2.0 is a Game Changer for Multiplatform Gamers
summary: Learn how Crossplay 2.0, exclusive to the Stealth™ Pro II wireless gaming headset, provides the ultimate convenience for gamers who play on multiple pla...
body_markdown:
You’re the kind of gamer who has it all. XBOX, PlayStation®, PC ­— if it runs a video game, it’s in your arsenal. You’re everyone’s favorite squadmate because no matter what platform your friends like to play, you’ve got it covered. Plus, if you ever get an itch to play a game on a different platform, you can hop over to a new one in as fast as it takes you to change the input channel on your screen. At least that’s the dream.


In reality, it can become a huge logistical headache to swap between different devices, and one common culprit is an unintuitive wireless headset. Simply, many headsets aren’t built to handle switching between multiple connections.


CrossPlay 2.0 changes all of that.


Available on the[Turtle Beach® Stealth™ Pro II Wireless Gaming Headset](https://www.turtlebeach.com/products/stealth-pro-ii-headset),


CrossPlay 2.0 supports up to four USB wireless transmitters (one transmitter and dock included with the headset, additional transmitters sold separately


), allowing seamless switching between XBOX, PlayStation®, PC —whatever you like— at the touch of a button.


No more pairing, no more fussing, no more wires. It even handles Bluetooth® and USB simultaneously.


Where else can you get connectivity like that?


You can’t.


That’s because CrossPlay 2.0 is the industry’s first and only wireless multiplatform transmitter system that allows you to wirelessly switch between up to four devices and is exclusive to the[Stealth™ Pro II.](https://www.turtlebeach.com/products/stealth-pro-ii-headset) The rest of the competition has all but ruled out serving multi-platform warriors like yourselves.


Okay, but is the audio actually good?


You bet.


Don't just take my word for it, though —


[TechRadar readers have given the Stealth™ Pro II Readers' Choice Awards for Gaming Device of the Year and Best Gaming Headset](https://www.techradar.com/tech/techradar-readers-choice-awards-2026-winners) . The[Stealth™ Pro II](https://www.turtlebeach.com/products/stealth-pro-ii-headset) is also certified by the Japan Audio Society for its Hi-Res Audio capabilities, delivering true24-bit/96kHz audio via an ultra-low-latency 2.4GHz wireless USB connection on compatible devices.


On top of that, you get 60mm Eclipse™ dual drivers with separate woofers & tweeters delivering powerful bass, detailed mids, and crisp highs with exceptional precision. The larger 60mm size moves more air for a richer, more immersive sound that outperforms conventional drivers. It’s audiophile grade sound designed with convenient connectivity in mind.


So when you swap your tired, wireless gaming headsets for the[Stealth™ Pro II](https://www.turtlebeach.com/products/stealth-pro-ii-headset) with Crossplay 2.0, you can finally achieve the hassle-free multi-device battle station you’ve always striven for, complete with premium audio and gaming-changing connectivity you literally can’t get anywhere else. It doesn’t get much better than that.
